faq_heading: Coquitlam Townhomes for Sale: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built from the boards' September 2026 statistics, the monthly SnapStats figures and Jared's MLS® closed sales (Nov 2025 to Oct 2026). No live feed filtered to this home type yet.

Coquitlam townhomes for sale: ground-level homes in strata buildings. The Greater Vancouver REALTORS® benchmark for townhomes in Coquitlam was $976,600 in September 2026 (-6.5% over a year). Before you offer, read the strata documents: the depreciation report, meeting minutes, bylaws and fees.
Coquitlam townhomes sold, November 2025 to October 2026

307 townhomes sold in Coquitlam with a median price of $1,000,000 (the middle half sold between $871,500 and $1,199,500), taking a median of 17 days to sell at 98.5% of the last list price; 7% sold above list. They had a median $638 per square foot, a median year built of 2020 and a median strata fee of $390 a month.

blocks.text: Coquitlam: the townhomes benchmark was $976,600 in September 2026. Over the past year it fell 6.5%; over three months it fell 3.9%; over the last month it was little changed (-1.2%, under the 1.5% we need before calling it a move). Longer term, over 3 years it fell 8.7%; over 5 years it rose 6.7%; over 10 years it rose 64.7%.
Townhomes against other home types in Coquitlam

Coquitlam: the townhomes benchmark of $976,600 sits $607,800 below the detached houses benchmark of $1,584,400 (62% of it) and $336,500 above the apartments (condos) benchmark of $640,100 (153% of it).

blocks.text: Before you buy townhomes in Coquitlam
Jared checks these with you on the exact address before you write an offer:

faq.q: What did townhomes in Coquitlam sell for?
faq.a: 307 townhomes sold in Coquitlam between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,000,000.

faq.q: How long do townhomes take to sell in Coquitlam?
faq.a: The median was 17 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 98.5% of the last list price (7% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What price range do most townhomes in Coquitlam sell in?
faq.a: The middle half of the 307 townhomes that sold in Coquitlam went for between $871,500 and $1,199,500, around a median of $1,000,000.

faq.q: Do townhomes in Coquitlam sell above asking price?
faq.a: 7% of the 307 townhomes sold for more than the last list price, and the median sale was 98.5% of it.

faq.q: What is a typical strata fee for townhomes in Coquitlam?
faq.a: Of the 307 sales, 303 listings gave a monthly fee and the median was $390.

faq.q: How old are the townhomes that sold in Coquitlam?
faq.a: The median year built was 2020 for the 307 townhomes sold in Coquitlam.

faq.q: How many bedrooms do townhomes in Coquitlam usually have?
faq.a: The median townhome that sold in Coquitlam had 3 bedrooms, from the 307 sales between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Which Coquitlam communities sold the most townhomes?
faq.a: By number sold: Burke Mountain (149), Coquitlam West (46), Westwood Plateau (33), for November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Which Coquitlam buildings sold the most townhomes?
faq.a: By number sold: Versant (12), Partington Creek (12), Beaumont By Polygon (11), for November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What is the benchmark price of a townhome in Coquitlam?
faq.a: The Greater Vancouver REALTORS® MLS® Home Price Index benchmark for townhomes in Coquitlam was $976,600 in September 2026, a modelled price for a typical home and not an average of sales.

faq.q: Did townhome prices fall in Coquitlam?
faq.a: Over the past year the benchmark fell 6.5%. Over three months it fell 3.9%. A change under 1.5% is not described as a rise or fall.

faq.q: Is Coquitlam a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In October 2026 houses in Coquitlam had a sales ratio of 14%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market, and condos and townhomes 16%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many townhomes are for sale in Coquitlam?
faq.a: The listing feed on this page shows what is active now, and the number changes daily. Ask Jared and he will send you the townhomes in Coquitlam that match what you want.
